stories.title: ‘Worth fighting for’: senators vow to restore financial watchdog agency after Guardian investigation
stories.summary: Democrats – including incoming banking chair and both majority leader candidates – said wealthy interests were prioritized over the needs of working Americans In response to a Guardian investigation , four US Senate Democrats say they will work to resurrect a financial watchdog agency that has abandoned dozens of enforcement actions under the second Trump administration . The Guardian found that after the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) dropped more than 20 lawsuits against banks and corporations accused of a range of financial misconduct, complaints against those firms rose by an average of more than 75%. In many of these recent complaints, consumers described the same issues the CFPB’s suits had sought to address. Continue reading...
